verdict.rationale: Several endpoints take natural-language input: Split sections, Classify/Route categories, edit/form-fill instructions, and agentic custom prompts. The official MCP server also lets users drive parse/extract/split/classify/edit by talking to agents in Claude, Cursor and similar tools. However, natural-language operation happens either inside programmatic API parameters or through a third-party agent client, not a first-party conversational interface, which counts as needing extra tools. Missing for 10: a native natural-language command interface in Reducto Studio or the CLI, and independent or hands-on corroboration of natural-language-driven operation.
